10 · Communication

Voice & tone

We write like a friend inviting you to a workout, not like a fitness influencer or a corporate app. Direct, warm, with zero pressure about looks or performance.

Energetic

Active verbs, short sentences. “Join in.” not “There is an opportunity to join.”

Inclusive

Every level is welcome. We never assume a fitness level or experience.

No pressure

Never a guilt trip about canceling, calories or looks. Moving is the reward in itself.

This is how we write

“Saturday morning run starts at 8am from Bundek. Easy pace, all levels welcome. See you there!”

This is not how we write

“You MUST come to this training or you'll lose your progress! Don't miss this CHANCE for the perfect body!!!”

This is how we write

“No worries, just let the organizer know you can't make it — the crew will understand.”

This is not how we write

“User has canceled attendance. Status: failure.”
